# Key flows from the 2.0.1 user report (run by 'make check').
# 1. Performance key enters Performance from every screen (spec 05 §2.5).
# 2. Master: F2..F5 open Reverb / Delay / Limiter / EQ, F8 returns; short
#    Master presses cycle Master 1/3 -> Track Mixer 2/3 -> Global Mixer 3/3;
#    a hold jumps to the Master main page (spec 06 §4.1-§4.3).
wait 300
tap PATTERN
expect-screen Pattern
tap PERFORMANCE
expect-screen Performance
tap SONG
expect-screen Song
tap PERFORMANCE 200
expect-screen Performance
tap INSTRPARAMS
tap PERFORMANCE
expect-screen Performance
tap SAMPLERECORDER
expect-screen Sample Recorder
tap PERFORMANCE 300
expect-screen Performance
tap CONFIG
tap PERFORMANCE 400
expect-screen Performance
tap FILE
tap PERFORMANCE 150
expect-screen Performance
tap SAMPLELOADER
tap PERFORMANCE 150
expect-screen Performance
tap SAMPLEPLAYBACK
tap PERFORMANCE
expect-screen Performance
tap MASTER 150
expect-screen Master
expect-master 0 0
tap F2 150
expect-master 0 1
tap F8 150
expect-master 0 0
tap F3 250
expect-master 0 2
tap F8
tap F4 400
expect-master 0 3
tap F8
tap F5 120
expect-master 0 4
tap F8
expect-master 0 0
tap MASTER 150
expect-master 1 0
tap MASTER 250
expect-master 2 0
tap MASTER 120
expect-master 0 0
tap MASTER
tap MASTER
expect-master 2 0
hold MASTER 600
expect-master 0 0
# The same while playing.
tap PLAY
wait 200
tap PERFORMANCE
expect-screen Performance
tap MASTER
expect-master 0 0
tap F3
expect-master 0 2
tap F8
tap MASTER
expect-master 1 0
tap PLAY
